story_zh: 小明是个诚实的小伙子，他喜欢弹钢琴。尽管他紧张，但坚持表演。演出精彩，观众表扬他。他流利地阅读一篇小说，词语幽默。他抱着一束花，动作浪漫。小明开心地说：“爱情让我幸福！”他得意地写日记，记录这幸福的心情。
story_pinyin: Xiǎomíng shì gè chéngshí de xiǎohuǒzi, tā xǐhuān tán gāngqín. Jǐnguǎn tā jǐnzhāng, dàn jiānchí biǎoyǎn. Yǎnchū jīngcǎi, guānzhòng biǎoyáng tā. Tā liúlì de yuèdú yī piān xiǎoshuō, cíyǔ yōumò. Tā bào zhe yī shù huā, dòngzuò làngmàn. Xiǎomíng kāixīn de shuō: “Àiqíng ràng wǒ xìngfú!” Tā déyì de xiě rìjì, jìlù zhè xìngfú de xīnqíng.
story_en: Xiaoming is an honest young man who likes to play the piano. Although he is nervous, he persists in performing. The performance is wonderful, and the audience praises him. He fluently reads a novel with humorous words. He holds a bouquet of flowers, his movements romantic. Xiaoming happily says, "Love makes me happy!" He proudly writes a diary, recording this happy mood.
